title: AI Voice Call: Grandchild Emergency
content: Grandma, it's me! I got into a bad car accident and I'm in jail. The police say I need $5,000 for bail right now. Please don't tell mom and dad. Send the money through Bitcoin or a wire transfer quickly!
explanation: Scammers use AI voice cloning from social media clips. Police and government agencies never ask for Bitcoin or wire transfers.

title: USPS Package Delivery Failure
content: USPS Notice: Your package could not be delivered due to an incomplete address. Please update your address and pay a $1.50 redelivery fee within 24 hours: https://usps-redelivery-postage.com
explanation: Look closely at the link address! Official postal links end in 'usps.com', not fake domains like 'usps-redelivery-postage.com'.

title: Tech Support Virus Warning Call
content: Hello, this is Microsoft Security Center calling. We detected a dangerous Trojan virus on your computer that is stealing your bank details. Please go to your computer immediately and download AnyDesk so we can fix it.
explanation: Companies like Microsoft or Apple will NEVER call you out of nowhere to fix your computer or request remote desktop access.

title: Bank Account Fraud Alert
content: CHASE ALERT: Urgent security notification. We detected suspicious activity of $482.91 at Walmart on your debit card. If this wasn't you, verify identity now: https://bit.ly/chase-secure-auth-392
explanation: Banks do not send shortened links like bit.ly in text messages. Always call the number on the back of your official debit card.

title: Verification Code Text
content: Your secure verification code for logging into Netflix is 482901. This code expires in 10 minutes. If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this text message.
explanation: This is a legitimate 2FA verification code. It does not ask you to click external links or send money.

title: Shipment Update
content: Hi John, your Amazon order #114-829371 has been delivered to your front door. Track or view details: https://www.amazon.com/gp/your-account/order-history
explanation: This is a legitimate delivery update pointing directly to the official, secure domain (amazon.com).

title: IRS Tax Penalty Threat Call
content: This is an urgent notice from the Internal Revenue Service. You have unpaid taxes of $3,210. A warrant has been issued for your arrest. To resolve this immediately and cancel the police dispatch, purchase Target gift cards and read the numbers on the back.
explanation: The IRS will never demand immediate payment over the phone, demand gift cards, or threaten instant arrest.

title: Prize Winner Text
content: CONGRATS! You have been selected as the 1st place winner of our daily giveaway: a brand new iPad Pro! Claim your prize here before midnight: https://claim-ipad-now-free.org/win
explanation: You cannot win a contest or giveaway that you never entered. These links trick you into entering credit card details for 'shipping fees'.

title: Prescription Reminder
content: CVS Pharmacy: Your prescription RX#94821 is ready for pickup at Main St branch. Reply 1 to auto-refill or CALL store directly for questions.
explanation: Standard automated pharmacy notice. It gives actionable options without requiring suspicious web links.

title: Bank Wire Transfer Call
content: This is Wells Fargo Fraud Prevention. Someone is currently attempting to transfer $2,500 out of your account. To stop this transaction, tell me the 6-digit passcode we just sent to your mobile phone number.
explanation: Scammers trigger a real password reset on your account and trick you into reading them the one-time passcode so they can log in!

title: Appointment Reminder
content: Reminder: You have an upcoming appointment with Dr. Smith tomorrow at 2:30 PM. Reply C to confirm or call 555-0192 to reschedule.
explanation: Normal SMS appointment reminder with standard text commands.

title: Wrong Number
content: Hi David! Are we still meeting for lunch at the country club tomorrow? Oh sorry, is this not David? Well, nice meeting you anyway! I am Sarah.
explanation: This is a classic 'Pig Butchering' or wrong number scam. Scammers pretend it was an innocent accident to build trust before pitching crypto investments.

title: Geek Squad Subscription Renewal Invoice
content: Geek Squad Auto-Renewal: $499.99 has been charged to your card for annual total tech protection. If you did not authorize this charge, call refund support immediately at 1-800-555-0199.
explanation: Scammers send fake invoice charges to induce panic so you call their fake call center, where they trick you into remote computer access.

title: Airline Flight Gate Change Notice
content: Delta Alert: Flight DL1482 to Chicago O'Hare now departing from Gate B12 at 4:15 PM. Check status in Delta mobile app.
explanation: Legitimate flight notification providing clear travel updates without asking for sensitive personal or payment details.

title: Electric Utility Shutoff Call
content: This is an urgent notice from City Power and Light. Your electricity account is past due by $310. Technicians are en route to shut off your power in 30 minutes unless you pay over the phone right now using a Zelle or prepaid Visa card.
explanation: Utility companies send formal mail notices before power disconnects and will never demand immediate payment via Zelle or prepaid cards over the phone.

title: Remote Work HR Job Offer
content: Congratulations! Your resume was selected for a remote Data Entry position paying $45/hour. No experience required. To secure your spot, purchase home office equipment via wire transfer using our approved vendor list.
explanation: Legitimate employers never ask prospective employees to wire money or buy equipment from specific vendors upfront.

title: Google Security Alert
content: Google Security Alert: A new sign-in was detected on a Mac device in Seattle, WA. If this was you, no action is needed. Review activity at https://myaccount.google.com/notifications
explanation: Official security notification pointing directly to the official google.com domain.

title: Unpaid Toll Road Fine Alert
content: Toll Notice: You have an unpaid toll invoice of $4.25 from recent highway travel. Final notice before a $50 late penalty is added. Pay online immediately: https://ezpass-toll-settlement-pay.com
explanation: Smishing scam! Look closely at the fake link (ezpass-toll-settlement-pay.com) instead of the official state toll portal.

title: Credit Card Cash Back Bonus
content: You have $184.20 in unclaimed cashback rewards expiring tonight! Click to transfer funds straight to your checking account: https://rewards-cash-payout.net
explanation: Banks allow you to claim rewards inside their official mobile app or online banking portal, never via suspicious third-party links.

title: Doctor Office Test Results
content: You have a new message and lab result available in your MyChart patient portal. Log in to your hospital portal or mobile app to view.
explanation: Standard notification directing you to log into your official patient portal without embedding external phishing links.

title: Social Security Number Suspension Call
content: Warning: Your Social Security Number has been suspended due to illegal drug trafficking activity connected to your name in Texas. Press 1 immediately to speak to an agent before a legal warrant is executed.
explanation: Social Security Numbers are NEVER suspended. The SSA will never call threatening arrest or demanding immediate phone resolution.

title: Library Book Overdue Notice
content: Library Notice: 'The Great Gatsby' was due yesterday. Please return it to the book drop or renew your loan online at citylibrary.org.
explanation: Informational library reminder pointing to official public domain.

title: Amazon Refund Customer Support Call
content: Hello, we are calling from Amazon. An order for a MacBook Pro ($1,299) was placed on your account. If you did not buy this, press 1 to connect with our refund department so we can deposit the money back into your bank account.
explanation: Amazon does not call customers about orders or demand phone access to process refunds.

title: PayPal Payment Receipt Confirmation
content: You sent $25.00 USD to Coffee Roasters LLC. Transaction ID: 89410294. View your receipt details by logging into paypal.com.
explanation: Standard payment receipt from PayPal.

title: Crypto Investment Opportunity Call
content: Hello! I am a senior financial analyst calling to offer an exclusive guaranteed 300% return on crypto trading. Deposit $500 today on our AI trading platform and watch your money double in 48 hours.
explanation: Guaranteed high returns do not exist. Any cold call promising risk-free high crypto returns is a scam.

title: Car Warranty Expiration Warning Call
content: This is your final notice regarding your vehicle's factory warranty. Our records indicate your coverage has expired. Press 1 now to extend your bumper-to-bumper warranty before you are liable for costly repairs.
explanation: Robocall scam harvesting credit card numbers under the guise of fake auto warranty renewals.

title: Hotel Reservation Confirmation Text
content: Your reservation #948210 for Marriott Downtown (Check-in: Oct 14) is confirmed. View reservation details in the Marriott app.
explanation: Legitimate hotel confirmation notice.

title: Urgent CEO Gift Card Request Email/Text
content: Hi, I am in a client meeting right now and cannot take calls. I need you to discreetly buy 5 Apple gift cards of $100 each for a client gift. Send me pictures of the redemption codes right away.
explanation: Classic Business Email Compromise (BEC) scam impersonating executives to steal gift cards.

title: School Weather Closure Notice
content: District Alert: All schools will be closed tomorrow, Friday Dec 8th, due to severe winter weather warnings. Stay safe!
explanation: Standard public school weather alert.

title: Parking Meter QR Code Payment
content: Parking Session Expiring: Pay $2.00 to extend your parking meter session by 1 hour now: https://city-park-meter-pay.quick-link.biz
explanation: Scammers place fake stickers with QR codes or links on parking meters that redirect to fraud payment sites.

title: Apple ID Security Lock Alert
content: Apple Alert: Your Apple ID has been locked due to unauthorized login attempts. Verify your payment info within 12 hours to prevent account deletion: https://appleid-verification-icloud-login.net
explanation: Apple will never threaten to delete your account via text or link you to fake domains like 'appleid-verification-icloud-login.net'.

title: Utilities Refund Check Call
content: Hello, we are calling to inform you that you overpaid your electric bill by $145.00 last month. To receive your refund check immediately, please verify your bank routing and account number over the phone.
explanation: Utility companies issue statement credits or send physical refund checks. They never ask for bank account numbers over the phone.

title: Uber Driver Arrival & Trip Receipt
content: Your Uber driver Alex (Toyota Camry, License #7ABC12) has arrived. Track trip details in the Uber app.
explanation: Standard ride-hailing notification directing you to use the official mobile app.

title: Jury Duty Warrant Arrest Threat Call
content: This is Officer Miller from the Sheriff Department. You failed to report for Jury Duty this morning. A judge has signed a warrant for your arrest. You must pay a $750 contempt fee via Bitcoin ATM to dismiss the warrant.
explanation: Police departments will never demand Bitcoin ATM payments or threaten instant arrest over missed jury duty.

title: Credit Card Transaction Fraud Response SMS
content: Citi Fraud Alert: Did you spend $89.50 at Target on card ending in 4102? Reply YES if recognized, or NO to block card.
explanation: Legitimate SMS fraud check. It only asks for a simple YES/NO reply without asking for personal information or web links.

title: Student Loan Debt Forgiveness Phone Call
content: Great news! Under new federal legislation, your student loans have been qualified for 100% debt cancellation. Press 1 now and pay a processing fee of $250 to clear your balance.
explanation: Federal loan forgiveness programs are free to apply for via StudentAid.gov. Never pay processing fees over the phone.

title: Cell Phone Network Tower Outage Notice
content: Verizon Notice: Maintenance on local cell towers near your area may cause brief signal interruption between 2 AM and 4 AM tonight.
explanation: Standard service announcement that requires no action or financial details.

title: Facebook Account Recovery Phishing Code
content: Meta Notice: Someone requested a password reset for your Facebook account. Click link to confirm it was you or change password: https://facebook-account-recovery-meta.com
explanation: Pay attention to the web link! Official Meta pages use facebook.com or meta.com, not 'facebook-account-recovery-meta.com'.

title: DoorDash Food Delivery Arrival
content: Hi! Your Dasher Maria has dropped off your food order at your front doorstep. Enjoy your meal!
explanation: Normal automated food delivery notification.

title: Fake Disaster Relief Fund Charity Call
content: Hello, we are calling on behalf of the Global Hurricane Emergency Relief Fund. Victims urgently need food and water. Donate $100 right now by reading your credit card details to our volunteer.
explanation: Scammers exploit natural disasters. Always donate directly through verified non-profit websites (e.g. RedCross.org).

title: Monthly Bank Statement Ready Email/Text
content: Bank of America: Your electronic bank statement for July is now available. Log in to Online Banking at bankofamerica.com to view.
explanation: Legitimate banking alert pointing directly to bankofamerica.com.

title: Tech Support Browser Popup Lockout Call
content: Warning! Your computer screen has been locked due to illegal spyware activity. Do not restart your PC. Call our toll-free hotline 1-888-555-0144 immediately to unlock your system.
explanation: Fake browser popups trick users into calling scam call centers. Windows does not lock your computer screen with phone numbers to call.

title: Veterinary Clinic Vaccination Reminder
content: Reminder: Buddy is due for annual Rabies and Distemper vaccinations this month. Call 555-0177 to schedule an appointment.
explanation: Standard veterinary clinic reminder with local contact info.

title: Crypto Airdrop Token Giveaway SMS
content: Binance Event: You received 500 USDT ($500) in our community airdrop! Connect your crypto wallet to claim: https://binance-airdrop-claim-wallet.org
explanation: Wallet-draining scam! Connecting your crypto wallet to unverified third-party sites gives scammers full control of your funds.

title: Public Transit Card Pass Auto-Reload
content: Metro Pass Alert: Auto-reload successful. $20.00 loaded onto Transit Card #9410. Current balance: $34.50.
explanation: Routine public transport automated confirmation.

title: Medicare Insurance Claim Overpayment Rebate
content: This is Medicare calling with an important update. You are eligible for a $400 health rebate check and a free back brace under new medical benefits. Please state your Medicare card number and birth date to confirm.
explanation: Medicare never calls beneficiaries out of the blue asking for Medicare numbers or offering free medical supplies.

title: Hardware Store Order Ready for Pickup
content: Home Depot: Order #W849201 is ready for store pickup at Customer Service Desk. Bring photo ID and confirmation code 4829.
explanation: Standard retail pickup notice.

title: Unclaimed Family Inheritance Email/Text
content: Greetings, I am a legal representative handling the estate of a late relative who shared your last name, leaving $4.5 Million USD. Contact me at law-chamber@mail.com to process your inheritance.
explanation: Classic 'Nigerian Prince' or advance-fee inheritance scam. Estate lawyers do not contact heirs via random text or free webmail accounts.

title: Calendar Meeting Invitation Notice
content: Notification: 'Weekly Team Sync' starting in 10 minutes (10:00 AM - 10:30 AM). Open Google Calendar app to join video call.
explanation: Standard calendar reminder notification.

title: Home Security Alarm Low Battery Alert
content: ADT Alert: Back Door Motion Sensor has a low battery (15%). Please replace CR123A battery soon to keep alarm system fully active.
explanation: Routine smart home system diagnostic message.
